QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] The Motes
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Lily on the rooftop.
QuestInfo.1: #bLily#k talked a little about monsters in this world. Enter the Dust Zone on the School Roof and eliminate the Motes. Collect 50 #bBizarre Dust Balls#k and then speak with #bLily#k again on the School Roof.
QuestInfo.2: You met Hawkeye, Mikhail, and Eckhart after eliminating the Motes on the rooftop. The rumors and misunderstandings about you are spiraling out of control.

default.0: I will wait here. We will talk further once you have defeated the monsters...\r\n#b(Defeat the Motes in the School Roof Dust Zone and bring back Bizarre Dust Balls.)#k
